notes_for_editor: The build date is only 'the 1930s' (NHLR), so no build year is recorded. The moved structure is the Witherbee lookout (data/towers/sc/us-sc-witherbee.json, verified): this record may duplicate it. A human should decide whether Bethera stays a separate relocation entry or is linked to Witherbee. The Witherbee record uses 1930 as a placeholder build year; this record does not. The FFLOS footers remark and the Firefighter Nation article are both undated. facts.status already reads 'relocated', so the gone-to-relocated change is already in facts; corrections[0].current ('gone') is stale and a human should review and clear that entry.
